summary: Signal-safety discipline for file-lock critical sections in daemon/shell code: never take a lock inside a signal handler; block or defer signals across the critical section before installing handlers. Established after a real self-deadlock race in scripts/sink-lock.sh (found under load stress, T118 of skill-overhaul-phase1: 25+ iterations at 46-70 load average, 0/150 hits post-fix).

memories.text: flock() called within signal handlers self-deadlocks via re-entrance: signal delivers inside critical section, handler opens second fd, blocks on own process. Fix: block signals (pthread_sigmask/trap deferral) around all lock critical sections before handlers are installed.
